title: SYOKAMI Japanese Kitchen Knife, 8.2 Inch Chef Knife, Carbon Steel Kiritsuke, Razor Sharp Santoku for Precision Cutting, Damascus Pattern, Full Tang Wood Handle,Thanksgiving Christmas Cooking Gifts

reviews.body: Use this alot, good feel and stays sharp, great on Veggies and on meat. Great buy

This is a really nice, solid knife. It is sharp and looks nice, but is also useful for many tasks. 2 things that I didn't enjoy- 1. The stain on the handle dropped on the counter when wet. Granted you are not supposed to let this knife soak in water, my fault, but I just got it pretty wet and that h...

At first I thought it was too long but after cutting vegetables with it, it’s a good length. It’s so sharp that you can shave the hair off your arm. I’m tempted to buy another one in case they stop selling them. Great knife!

I own 3 different styles of Syokami knives, each is SHARP and well made. Each is great to me, handle is solid, blade material is nice and strong and looks good. This is my go to blade for everything, weight is perfect for cutting meat or vegetables, even thinly slices.
Love this knife I used it today it cuts like butter. It cost it great for what it is. It's a well made knife and is light weight. It has a wood handle for grip.
